rows.reasoning: She cosponsored H.R. 38, which lets a person with a home-state permit carry a concealed handgun in other states, meeting the 'loosen rules on carrying, such as honoring permits across state lines' part of the rung 'Add no new restrictions, and at most loosen rules on carrying'. She also voted Yea on H.J.Res. 44, nullifying a new ATF rule on braced firearms, a recorded vote against a new restriction, which the annex requires as the second passage. No record repeals a major federal law, so the repeal-and-permitless-carry rung is not reached.
